{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for converted = 1 and status = 'completed'
converted_completed = df[(df['converted'] == 1) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Count the number of such rows
num_converted_completed = len(converted_completed)

# Exclude rows where customer_age == -1 (missing age sentinel)
valid_ages = converted_completed[converted_completed['customer_age'] != -1]

# Count the number of valid age entries
num_valid_ages = len(valid_ages)

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_ages['customer_age'].mean()

# Print all required numbers
print(f'Number of converted and completed orders: {num_converted_completed}')
print(f'Number of valid ages (excluding -1): {num_valid_ages}')
print(f'Mean age: {mean_age}')"}
